description: This file defines an interface for digital signature generation within the PDFsharp library, specifically in the PdfSharp.Pdf.Signatures namespace. It declares methods for obtaining signature size and signature data from a stream, and a property for the certificate name.

classes.name: IDigitalSigner
classes.description: An interface for classes that generate digital signatures, providing methods and properties related to digital signing processes.

methods.name: CertificateName
methods.description: Property that retrieves the human-readable name of the certificate used for signing.

methods.name: GetSignatureSizeAsync
methods.description: Asynchronous method that returns the size of the digital signature in bytes, used for reserving space in the PDF.

methods.name: GetSignatureAsync
methods.description: Asynchronous method that retrieves the digital signature bytes from a provided stream.
